art-residencies.headline: Aesthetica Art Prize
art-residencies.summary: Based on discussion on X, Aesthetica Magazine is accepting submissions for the Aesthetica Art Prize, offering winning contemporary artists a top award of £10,000 alongside inclusion in an exhibition and publication. This call is a prize opportunity open to artists working across photography, painting, sculpture, digital art, and other contemporary art disciplines. Specific entry fees, career stage requirements, geographic eligibility, and full submission guidelines are not detailed in the post. The deadline stated in the discussion is 11 October. Other financial and logistical details are not stated, and funding status is funding-unclear.

art-residencies.headline: Goethe-Institut Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture: WP4 Visual Arts Grant (Lot 2)
art-residencies.summary: Based on the linked discussion, the Goethe-Institut's Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture programme is inviting creatives, researchers, and multidisciplinary professionals to apply for the WP4 Visual Arts grant (Lot 2) under its Sub-Saharan Africa component. The opportunity is a grant supporting collaborative cultural work across Africa and Europe. The location is not stated. The exact application deadline, project dates, duration, specific eligibility criteria, and required submission materials are not specified in the source. Grant amounts, artist fees, and related financial provisions are not stated. Funding is funding unclear.
